title: Source-bound weekly irrigation timing counter and deficit gate

source.equation: Increment dayfix once on entry; when the incremented value is at least seven, reset it to zero and trigger only when 10*cdef_cm > irgthreshold_mm.
source.restart_domain: The source's dormant restart read accepts dayfix 0 through 366; the normal crop-rotation initialization sets the first value to 366.

scope: pure TCS6 day-counter transition and strict weekly deficit comparison only
startup sentinel 366, ordinary within-week values 0 through 6, threshold equality and strict sides
100000 deterministic source-equation comparisons at O0 and O2 with transcript identity
non_goals: daily process invocation/calendar proof, event selection or irrigation amount/rate
fixed interval TCSFIX interaction, generic management parser or event-calendar ingestion
scheduled irrigation runtime, source booking, retry/restart or production admission
new state owner or restart schema
pass_conditions: the isolated helper matches the exact B1.11 increment/reset/strict comparison
the 366 startup sentinel performs the source's immediate first-week test and then resets to zero
the counter resets every seventh increment, independent of whether the threshold triggers
production and calendar admission remain NONE
